channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Temporal Storage
item.description: A simple Storage Solution using the power of Temporal Entanglement! (Now with actual sorting~)

item.title: Stacksize Tooltips
item.description: Adds a tooltip for maximum stack size, mod compatible

item.title: Valley of Ashes
item.description: Craft wood and plant ash, ash sludge and optional potash.

item.title: Bookbinders
item.description: Adds new books, items and tools related to book crafting.

item.title: Dead
item.description: Leaves a lootable corpse of the player (with their exact skin and worn gear) at the death spot

item.title: Upholstery
item.description: Craft furniture and interior decorations.

item.title: Dressmakers
item.description: Add crafting recipes for almost all VS clothing items

item.title: Expanded Matter
item.description: Library for ore, materials and item variants. Extends VS existing ore.

item.title: Bricklayers
item.description: More clay, bricks, porcelain, glazings, colored glass, luminous glass.

item.title: Wool 🙵 More
item.description: Harvest, process, trade and craft with animal fleece and wool.

item.title: Tailor's Delight
item.description: Craft and decorate with cloth, leather and hide.

item.title: VS Village
item.description: Adds villages and villagers to the world.

item.title: CFY Simple Hotbar Refill
item.description: Automatically refills tools, blocks, and items in the hotbar.

item.title: Carry On
item.description: Adds the capability to carry various things. Replaces CarryCapacity.

item.title: Good Hunting
item.description: Buffed and varied vanilla drops for animals for realism.

item.title: LauncherGo
item.description: LauncherGo is a graphical server launcher for Vintage Story.

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: Nimbus - A Server proxy for Vintagestory.
item.description: Put many backends behind one address, move players between them on demand.

item.title: Antique Harmony | Music Additions / Alternative Soundtrack
item.description: Adds to/replaces soundtrack with original orchestral one, written for the game.

item.title: Ingenium
item.description: Mechanical power, corrected.

item.title: Boric Alchemy
item.description: Boric Alchemy adds chemical routes to create and refine resources, and create alchemical marvels!

item.title: Land Of Estrellas
item.description: The offical modpack of The Land of Estrellas server

item.title: Angler's Catch
item.description: Adds length and size to the vanilla fish, fish in the top 20% get a Trophy Tag

item.title: The Crown & The Coalition Server Tweaks
item.description: Server tweaks for The Crown & The Coalition.

item.title: Tyeia's Boat Speed Tweaks
item.description: Adjusts the speed of boats and provides configuration for boat speed.

item.title: Global Illuminator
item.description: An early version of global illumination, skylighting and parallax designed to work with Sheydermod

item.title: Keyring - CO Fork Compatability
item.description: Adds a wearable keyring capable of holding up to six keys from the Thievery mod. This release update

item.title: Auto Walk Extended
item.description: Toggle walking/running. Options to toggle sneaking and automatic climbing.

item.title: Smooth Rock Strata
item.description: Adds smoothing to rock strata boundaries

item.title: Snowshoes Cordage Compatibility
item.description: Adds alternative Snowshoes recipes using dry sinew or any Wool & More twine.
